description: Multi-layer TEG model: SiGe inner + outer couples, T-dependent ZT, decay heat, thermal resistance network

unit.name: GPHS-RTG (Pu-238, SiGe multi-layer TEG) — temperature-dependent material model
unit.source: Bennett (2006) Acta Astronautica; El-Genk & Saber (2005) Energy Convers. Mgmt. 46; Fleurial et al. (1997) Proc. 16th IECEC; NASA GPHS-RTG documentation

n_couples_inner.note: Number of inner (hot-side) SiGe couples per GPHS-RTG

n_couples_outer.note: Outer unicouple (set 0 for single-stage; >0 activates cascaded model)

alpha0_SiGe.note: Seebeck coefficient of SiGe n-type at T_ref (~200-250 uV/K, GPHS unicouples; Fleurial 1997)

k0_SiGe.note: Thermal conductivity of SiGe at T_ref (3-4 W/m/K)

sigma0_SiGe.note: Electrical conductivity of SiGe at T_ref (~4-6 x10^4 S/m; degenerate n-type)

T_ref_K.note: Reference temperature for SiGe property fits (mid-range ~800 C)

a1_SiGe.note: Seebeck linear T-coefficient (negative: decreasing at very high T)

b1_SiGe.note: Thermal conductivity linear T-coefficient (negative: phonon-glass behavior)

c1_SiGe.note: Electrical conductivity linear T-coefficient (positive for degenerate semiconductor)

L_element_m.note: Length of one unicouple element (GPHS-RTG unicouple ~19 mm)

A_element_m2.note: Cross-section area of one couple (hot-shoe area ~32 cm^2 / 100 couples = 3.2e-4 m2 per couple)

R_thermal_hot_K_W.note: Hot-side thermal resistance (hot shoe + gap ~0.02 K/W per couple aggregate)

R_thermal_cold_K_W.note: Cold-side thermal resistance (radiator fin ~0.05 K/W aggregate)
